text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~...
I couldn't stand in the center position~...
choice_data_list: Still, that was a great concert.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Winning Lives really are amazing, huh.
Falco is so deeply moved!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Just being able to sing and dance in front of everyone
was so much fun!
choice_data_list: Being in the center must be even more fun

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
All right! Next live,
Falco's definitely standing in center stage!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"And on top of that!
Aim for the top☆ Umadol~!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon refocused her determination.
Even during our meeting to decide future plans,
she looked full of motivation—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Pop quiz! What is the very first thing a rookie Umadol fresh off her debut should do?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Bzzzzt!
Well, okay, maybe not totally wrong, but still!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
The correct umadol answer is,
"Total grassroots hustle! Win over fans at live shows!"☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I want to run in lots of races
and stand in the center stage for real this time!
choice_data_list: Then first, we gotta win the Debut/Maiden race.
Then first, we have to win the Debut/Maiden race.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right...!
The races I can still enter are limited.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume who don't win their debut race
must next challenge a Maiden race.
Clear that, and they move on to the next stage—
choice_data_list: Let's take 1st place in a higher-level race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If she keeps taking 1st place in those,
naturally, the spotlight on her will continue to grow.
choice_data_list: Win at least two races, and popularity will follow.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Okey-doke☆
As long as I win, right?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure everyone remembers
the rookie Umadol, Falco~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the Junior Class goal was set
to raise her profile by winning
at least two Pre-OP or higher races.
